title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing: Filing a Completed Inspection and Its Interval
content:
Where an inspection of a vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing has been completed, it is filed on the vehicle's condition record together with the mileage interval it grants. One entry carries the odometer the vehicle was inspected at, what the inspection found, how it was carried out and the miles of interval it grants, and that same figure is booked to the vehicle's inspection mileage credit as the interval the entry adds. The listing's class, price and standing are untouched; what the host sees afterwards is an inspection entry dated today with the interval it granted.

A completed inspection is filed at the odometer the record of the inspection carries, with the finding that record reached, and through the channel the inspection was carried out under.

### Making the entry

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `record_vehicle_inspection_59fe0be1` and calls it. One call files one inspection.

### Parameters

- `vehicle_id` — the listing reference number of the vehicle inspected, read from the vehicle listing lookup before the call.
- `customer_id` — the member reference number of the host who owns that listing, read from the member profile lookup before the call.
- `odometer_reading` — the odometer the vehicle was inspected at, in whole miles as an integer, with no decimal part, no unit suffix and no thousands separator.
- `inspection_outcome` — what the inspection found, exactly one of: `not_applicable`, the record is not an inspection and reaches no finding; `passed`, the vehicle met every standard checked with nothing to note; `passed_with_advisories`, the vehicle met every standard but something was noted for the host to watch; `failed`, the vehicle did not meet a standard checked.
- `inspection_channel` — how the inspection was carried out, exactly one of: `self_photo`, the host photographed the vehicle against the checklist themselves; `partner_shop`, a partner workshop inspected the vehicle on its premises; `mobile_inspector`, a marketplace inspector attended the vehicle and inspected it; `telematics_report`, the fitted telematics unit supplied the inspection evidence.
- `interval_miles_granted` — the mileage interval this inspection grants before the next one falls due, in whole miles as an integer, with no decimal part, no unit suffix and no thousands separator; it is booked to the vehicle's inspection mileage credit as whole miles, signed, a positive addition of the same size.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number minted for the new inspection record, the listing it was filed against, what the inspection found and the mileage interval granted. The presence of that reference number in the sentence is what indicates the inspection and its interval now stand on the vehicle's condition record.
